title: kate-core: complete a word that contains a Unicode letter
summary: is_word_char treats a Unicode letter as a word character. The prefix caf then offers café. The suffix is é. The test goes in the existing completion tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: completion.rs has one test module named tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Change only is_word_char. The body is ch == '\'' || ch.is_alphanumeric() || ch == '_'. Do not nest an if inside an if. Do not touch has_ascii_prefix, matches_between, completion_suffix, rewind_word, forward_word, or word_completions. Update the doc comment on word_completions. The old sentence says a word is a run of ASCII letters, digits, and _. Replace that sentence. The new sentence says a word is a run of Unicode letters, Unicode digits, an apostrophe, and _. You may update that comment. Do not change the assertions in these tests. They stay green: prefix_lists_later_words_once, a_repeated_word_stays_once, the_match_ignores_ascii_case, completion_suffix_is_the_rest_of_the_word, completion_suffix_skips_a_copied_tail, an_empty_prefix_and_a_zero_limit_stay_empty, an_apostrophe_stays_inside_the_word, and a_capital_word_completes_a_lower_prefix. The test a_unicode_letter_stays_inside_the_word uses TextBuffer::from_str of café, space, caf. word_completions at Offset(8) with limit 4 returns a vector whose one item is café. completion_suffix at Offset(8) returns Some of é. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines. Run the full test module named in the commands, not only the new test.

regression_tests.name: completion::tests::a_unicode_letter_stays_inside_the_word
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. The list at the end of café caf is caf. After the change the one item is café and the suffix is é. The typed prefix caf is already removed.
